summary: Configured node1 as the cluster NTP source and node2 to synchronize exclusively from node1. Both nodes retained configuration and recovered successfully after sequential reboots.
actions_performed: Configured node1 chronyd to allow node2 (10.100.62.11/32).
Persistently enabled NTP through node1's firewall.
Replaced node2's public/DHCP time sources with node1 (10.100.62.10).
Validated configurations and confirmed live synchronization.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified persistence and recovery.

evidence.requirement: node2 synchronizes against node1 instead of public servers
